### Showing Our Troubles to God
Author: Wendy Pope
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/showing-our-troubles-to-god-encouragement-for-today-november-19-2015.html
Passage: 2 Kings 19:3
Points:
- Overwhelming and compounding crises can quickly deplete a person's physical and emotional strength.
- When facing severe intimidation and distress, King Hezekiah acknowledged his complete lack of strength.
- Godly friends provide comfort, but believers should present their anxieties to God first.
- Spreading out our troubles before the Lord replaces panic with His divine peace.
